name: Fusion EMS
old_description: Fusion specializes in turnkey and consigned EMS strategies, with a focus on high-mix, low-to-medium and high-volume production. We leverage deep expertise and a wide range of capabilities to develop custom solutions for our customers, and support your program every step of the way.
about:
Fusion EMS operates from Hillsboro, Oregon, in the Pacific Northwest. The company has spent three decades providing electronics manufacturing services, though a specific founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

Fusion EMS specializes in turnkey and consigned electronic manufacturing services (EMS), focusing on high-mix, low-to-medium and high-volume production. Its capabilities include conformal coating and potting, test development, box-build assembly, new product introduction (NPI) support, quick-turn prototyping, component purchasing and inventory management, and custom supplier strategies. The company emphasizes robust processes such as engineering meetings, alternate component sourcing, and statistical process control (SPC) with DMAIC principles. All production personnel are trained and certified to IPC Class III standards, and assemblies receive serial-number tracking.

Fusion EMS serves customers in aerospace, medical and life sciences, industrial, and military and defense sectors. Its services are geared toward original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) requiring high-reliability electronics manufacturing, from prototype through full production and product retirement.

Fusion EMS differentiates itself by offering custom solutions and supporting customer programs through every stage, leveraging deep expertise and a broad capability set.
